checks.heading_visible: the screen heading (semantics role heading) is on screen
checks.palette_applied: palette groups only: the palette was chosen through the Settings UI and its note appeared
checks.no_page_errors: no uncaught page errors while the cell was open (load errors count to the first cell of a page)
checks.no_console_errors: no console messages of type error
checks.no_failed_requests: no failed request and no HTTP status >= 400
checks.no_horizontal_scroll: document scrollWidth <= viewport width at every scroll position
checks.controls_named: every semantics button, link and tab has a non-empty accessible name
checks.touch_targets: touch viewports: every enabled semantics button/link/tab/checkbox/switch/radio/slider or tappable node is >= 48x48 CSS px (48 dp since Q005) (largest size seen while scrolling the whole screen); the modal barrier above a sheet ("Scrim") is not counted
checks.no_flutter_overflow: debug build of the same revision: the console has no "overflowed by N pixels" report while the screen is opened and scrolled
checks.no_flutter_exceptions: debug build: no other Flutter framework exception report
checks.lock_state_clear: Settings: app lock: in a build without an encrypted vault the reason text is shown and every lock control (minute chips, lock-when-hidden switch) is disabled
checks.about_sections_clear: Settings: about: both section titles ("This build" and "Capabilities on this device", EN/TR) are exposed as standalone headings, not merged with their cards
checks.lab_group_chart_spoken: Labs: same test over time: "Same test over time" is exposed as its own heading on Labs and the group chart carries its spoken dated-values summary
checks.restore_chooser_opens: Today: restore from file: tapping the entry opens the browser file chooser
checks.restore_cancel_reported: Today: restore from file: closing the chooser without a file shows "No file chosen. Nothing was changed." on screen within 1 s
checks.not_cut_at_list_end: U042: every target the script scrolled to ended at least 2 px above the bottom navigation bar (in a sheet, above its pinned Save bar, U044; else the window bottom); one that stops moving at the end of its list with its bottom still under the bar is a finding (cut at list end), not in view
checks.no_stacked_headings: Q005: no heading has another heading as the next visible text directly below it in the same column (less than 32 px between them, nothing in between)
checks.no_english_on_tr: Q005, tr-TR cells: no accessible label or heading seen while sweeping the screen contains an English word from a fixed list (names shared by both languages allowed)
checks.theme_applied: U045: every group without a palette: the cell's screenshot is read back and its most common colour is a surface, card or raised container of the expected theme, or one of them under the black 54 % modal barrier (dark by default; light in the groups that chose Light in Settings, whose chip must also read as checked), those three covering at least 25 % of the window (every 4th pixel, each channel within 3)
checks.chip_checked: Q007 (U043) chip cells: the chip the cell selected is a semantics checkbox with aria-checked=true; U044: the cell selected it itself (it was not checked before its tap, and is after); a chip that starts checked fails
checks.title_whole: Q005: first run, Summary, Derived and how-to titles: the title box lies wholly inside the window at the top of the page
checks.howto_no_numbers: Q005 (U041): the how-to has at least six task headings and no heading or label starts with a number
checks.switch_help_read_with_switch: Q005 (U041): the Timeline "show deleted and withdrawn" switch is one control whose accessible name includes its help line
checks.rail_in_window: Q008 compact-rail groups only (840 and 1000 wide): at least 11 rail items (4 primary, 6 areas, Settings), each ending within 81 px from the left and above the window bottom (U044: the rail stays 80 dp wide); U045: only buttons and tabs inside the rail's own semantics node count (the outermost node within 81 px of the left edge, at least 200 px tall, above a control near the left edge)
checks.text_scaled_2x: 2× text cells only (every group with a browser font size, against the 1× group it names, U044): the heading (on Settings the first content heading; Flutter caps top-bar titles near 1.34×) is at least 1.6× as tall as at 1×, so the setting reached the app
